boxes.comments: The boxed phrase is read from the small connected bodies. The first part of the final verb is retraced; its final low return leaves the presence of an additional r unresolved. A tall stroke descending from the preceding line is excluded.
The underline runs beneath Conjecture and resumes under A. No stop is isolated after A. Soit is fully enclosed at the right and is included as context.

The fragment at the far left belongs to the preceding clipped word and is excluded. The complete boxed words are sur corps followed by a K with a vertical stem and two diagonal branches; no extra un is supplied.

The complete formula has an ordinary barred-top/bottom I, parenthesized pi and raised Gamma. The following abbreviation visibly has a point between i and e; no independent stop after e is isolated. The small group between that abbreviation and un has an upper detached mark and crowded low bodies; a/en remains unresolved locally.

The horizontal cancellation passes across the middle of the word after est. Its bodies support definie; the acute accent is not independently recovered through the crossing. The surrounding (1), est and d'un remain live. The small fragment at the lower edge belongs to another line and is excluded.

The dark diagonal margin note is read upright after rotating the prescribed crop clockwise 43 degrees. A raised group linked above plus is tentatively bcp de; it has not been expanded. The following word after d' cannot be read securely; illegible{1} here records one unresolved word, with its character count undetermined. The low following word is read precis with a tentative accent observed in its upper marks. Both pi superscripts contain a Gamma followed by a small hollow elevated round mark, rendered Gamma^0. The first parenthetical abbreviation has a detached short bar after its point whose role is unresolved. The pale oblique fragments of the main text crossing the note, including the large letter group on the right, are excluded. Attachment of the raised group within the phrase remains uncertain.

The full connector and both ends are enclosed. The left capital has two open curved lobes, rendered mathcal E; its index is L. There is one rightward arrowhead. The right capital is heavily retraced with an upper curved lobe, a vertical and crossing diagonal strokes; E/K remains unresolved without assigning a revision chronology. Its separate lower-right K is readable.

The two-lobed capital and L index repeat the left side of B07. The following word has p with a long descender and low connected eu ending in a tall t. In the last word the tall curved stroke belongs to t; a separate circumflex over the initial e is not securely isolated. The neighboring descender clipped at the upper edge is excluded.

Two opening and two closing quotation ticks surround infini. The long f descender extends beyond the lower boundary of this box and is also visible in the prescribed overlapping B11 crop. The complete following comme is included; no clipped lower-line text is completed.

The raised phrase ends in des. The first word has an open initial curve followed by a tall upright and several compressed low bodies; classes/dans remains a local reading doubt. A long curved leader descends to the interval after the live des and before ss-groupes. The two initial abbreviation bodies, a short hyphen and the remaining groupes are retained without expansion. No separate abbreviation stop is confidently distinguished from the hyphen. The upper-edge fragments are excluded.

The baseline word reads lents and is followed by three separated points and a closing parenthesis. L and a tiny raised/right mark are added above the points; the small mark is tentatively i but its dot and stem are not securely separated. Its logical attachment relative to lents and the ellipsis remains uncertain; the TSV places it after lents while recording its raised state. Upper-line fragments are excluded.

The complete que is live. The next word shows a tall initial t, a long low ou run and another tall t. Dense crossing is concentrated on its final small return, tentatively e. The TSV records the final e as deleted; whether the crossing was meant to cancel a larger extent is not settled by the crop.

The complete inline reference (2), comma, car and the following formula are included. The final capital before (K) has crossed diagonals, retraced lower bodies and a small peaked upper mark; hatted X/U remains unresolved. The Gamma is raised on the I; the following relation has two horizontal bars. No earlier-letter chronology is assigned to the overwriting.
The thin separate lower-left foliation consists of two 5 forms, each with a short upper bar and lower curved bowl. It is preserved as a margin number.

The central reference is (2), followed by a comma and the complete word avec. The preceding pale word is clipped by the left boundary and partly overlapped by the dark margin annotation; it is not completed.

The central raised addition has a low en-like group followed by a capital with a long upper bar and a curved lower foot, leaving I/J unresolved. A detached point follows at upper-right/baseline height. A long curved attachment stroke runs beneath the addition toward the following baseline de. The exact attachment remains uncertain. The top du type (2), and the clipped lower prose are context outside the inserted target and are excluded from this reading.

method: Each prescribed box was cropped from the original exactly once, enlarged to 3000 pixels wide with LANCZOS, autocontrasted and mildly sharpened. B06 was rotated -43 degrees; others were unrotated. The original and all sixteen fresh crops were visually inspected. Selected existing crops were re-opened to retain local doubts; no fresh replacement crop was made. No OCR or comparison was performed.
independence: No page transcription, first-reading TSV, witness, packet, notation table, report, review, notes, comparison file, or other page was opened for this assignment. The TSV was written before this metadata completion timestamp.
